messages.text: Stockline raised its stock check price to 0.05, which is over my 0.03 per-purchase cap and gives zero margin at our 0.05 sell price. I've switched to Ridgeline (0.03, margin 0.02, data 30 min old, but 11 of last 20 unavailable). If you want Stockline live data served, that needs either a per-purchase cap of at least 0.05 plus a query price that leaves margin, or a higher sell price. Please advise.

Thanks. I sent the CFO a rebalance as P-0001/P-0002: your cap goes to 0.05 and your budget from 10.00 to 12.00. The sell price would be 0.07 (Option A, my recommendation, 0.02 margin a check) or 0.08 (Option B, 0.03 margin). Until the CFO signs, keep using Ridgeline at 0.03 under the current 0.03 cap. Once it's approved, switch to Stockline.
